@about: Animated help clips (UI-107), played by ClipView (app/HelpClip.hpp): vector items keyframed in seconds, model coordinates in millimetres (plane view: x right, y up; iso view: z up). Captions, label/chip texts and card titles/rows are English source text translated through app/i18n/<lang>/help.json. All artwork is original and procedural.
